claims.reason: Only the reduced DAE-shaped fixture is replayed here; the full composition and canonical tool adoption remain open.

tcb: Pinned Rust 1.100.0-nightly 2026-08-18, Charon candidate4 and Aeneas candidate stack; translator semantic correctness is not proved here.
Pinned Lean 4.31.0 kernel and imported model library; admitted theorem transitive axioms exactly propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

New expect_failed definition is a trusted typed library abstraction, not proof of Rust panic implementation. It shares existing Option.expect abstraction: panic formatting, hooks, output, allocation and unwinding are outside the observation model.
The model is restricted to core::option::expect_failed(&str)->!; it does not bind generic Display, arbitrary panic_display, or arbitrary Never-returning functions.
Brand marker functionalization inherits the existing translation model; no Rust branding, ownership or production type change.
construction: Some/None source branches remain in translated nominal specialized Option bodies. Only the leaf library call has a model; impossible successful Never values are eliminated by the separately bounded-reviewed Never candidate.
preservation: No Rumoca production source, live tool pin or .lake source/output changed. The String proof edit changes no argument type, bound or value body. Compiler runtime performance is therefore unaffected by mechanism; no benchmark claimed.
not_run: Canonical cargo xtask verify lean-pilot integration: candidate dependency stack not adopted.
New full upstream Aeneas/Charon suite: this packet exercises the declared bounded library path only.
cargo xtask verify quick/full rerun: no dependency-closed adoption milestone; last quick remains red as recorded in roadmaps.
Remote CI and full MSL parity sweep: not a compiler capability change; no cohort claim.
replay_notes: Commands and cwd fields are recorded in runs. LEAN_PATH orders the selected generated directory, isolated complete Std namespace, then pinned dependencies.

Fresh final source is candidate fixture.rs. Older diagnostic runs retain historical outputs and may point at subsequently revised proof files; only fresh/guarded rows bind final proof bytes.
Mutant proof runs intentionally fail; sorryAx in their failed elaboration diagnostics is rejected by guards, never accepted as proof.
